newsitem.title: USA: Hibernia seeks to raise $100 mln in offering.
newsitem.headline: Hibernia seeks to raise $100 mln in offering.

text.p: Hibernia Corp said on Friday that it has begun efforts to raise $100 million through a fixed-rate adjustable preferred stock offering.
A shelf registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission filed on July 15 became effective on Thursday, the company said.

The non-convertible preferred stock will be redeemable after five years; dividends are not cumulative, the company said. The company said funds from the offering will "significantly strengthen capital ratios, allowing us to act quickly when opportunities to further enhance the value of our franchise arise."
Morgan Stanley & Co Inc will lead the offering, with syndicate members Bear, Stearns & Co Inc, Lehman Brothers and Salomon Brothers Inc.
The company expects to have assets of $8.9 billing after the pending mergers with Texarkana National Bank in east Texas and St. Bernard Bank & Trust Co in New Orleans.
